changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
create or alter view [dbo].[IntersectTypeDetail] as SELECT IT.uid, IT.ID, IT.SourceID, IT.[State], iif (IT.SubjectClass = 9 and IT.SubjectAssetTypeID = 0, 'Reference List', SATT.Name) + ' ' + P.Name + ' ' + iif (IT.ObjectClass = 9 and IT.ObjectAssetTypeID = 0, 'Reference List', OATT.Name) as Name, coalesce(IT.SubjectClass, 0) as SubjectClass, IT.SubjectAssetTypeID, SATT.Uid as SubjectUid, IT.SubjectCardinality, iif (IT.SubjectClass = 9 and IT.SubjectAssetTypeID = 0, 'Reference List', SATT.Name) AS SubjectName, COALESCE (SIcon.IconBackColor, '#000') AS SubjectIconBackColor, COALESCE (SIcon.IconForeColor, '#fff') AS SubjectIconForeColor, COALESCE (SIcon.IconText, SUBSTRING(COALESCE (SATT.Name, 'Re'), 1, 2)) AS SubjectIconText, case when IT.SubjectClass = 9 and SubjectAssetTypeID = 0 then 'Reference List' else SP.Path end as SubjectAssetTypePath, coalesce(IT.ObjectClass, 0) as ObjectClass, IT.ObjectAssetTypeID, OATT.Uid as ObjectUid, IT.ObjectCardinality, iif (IT.ObjectClass = 9 and IT.ObjectAssetTypeID = 0, 'Reference List', OATT.Name) AS ObjectName, COALESCE (OIcon.IconBackColor, '#000') AS ObjectIconBackColor, COALESCE (OIcon.IconForeColor, '#fff') AS ObjectIconForeColor, COALESCE (OIcon.IconText, SUBSTRING(COALESCE (OATT.Name, 'Re'), 1, 2)) AS ObjectIconText, case when IT.ObjectClass = 9 and ObjectAssetTypeID = 0 then 'Reference List' else OP.Path end as ObjectAssetTypePath, IT.PredicateID, P.Uid as PredicateUid, P.Name AS PredicateName, P.Inverse AS PredicateInverse, P.Type AS PredicateType, COALESCE (IT.IsSystem, CAST(0 AS bit)) AS IsSystem FROM IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = IT.PredicateID left join AssetType SATT ON SATT.ID = IT.SubjectAssetTypeID left join AssetTypeStyle SIcon on SIcon.ID = SATT.ID outer apply dbo.GetAssetTypeTextPathById(SATT.ID, ' / ') SP
left join AssetType OATT ON OATT.ID = IT.ObjectAssetTypeID left join AssetTypeStyle OIcon on OIcon.ID = OATT.ID outer apply dbo.GetAssetTypeTextPathById(OATT.ID, ' / ') OP
